name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. Changelog (last 3): 1.4.0 — `/git:enter-worktree` is now the manual repair surface for a spec's worktree rather than a documented pre-step, because the spec loop opens the worktree itself before any stage runs; its Step 2 gains an already-inside short-circuit, so re-entering the tree the session is already in reports re-entered and stops without re-running host setup or rewriting the recorded base branch. 1.3.0 — `/git:commit`'s step 3 escape check runs `commit-coverage.js` (via `spec-paths commit-coverage`) instead of the retired git-blame/jq heuristic, gated on a fix-typed commit subject, and offers on any touched file a reviewed spec landed — still never blocking the commit.
